name: OKC_ART_INT_ERRORS
description: This table stores all the errors encountered during the clause import process. This is the error table for OKC Clause Library Open Interface. Scope: public Lifecycle: active Display Name: OKC Clause Import Error Interface Product: OKC Category: BUSINESS_ENTITY OKC_LIBRARY_CLAUSE

columns.name: BATCH_PROCESS_ID
columns.description: The batch process for which the error was encountered. Foreign Key  to OKC_ART_INT_BATPROCS.BATCH_PROCESS_ID.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: The interface row that has failed validation. Foreign key to OKC_ART_INTERFACE_ALL.INTERFACE_ID.

columns.name: ERROR_NUMBER
columns.description: Sequential number generated for each run. This does not use any sequence but a running number for each process.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ERROR_TYPE
columns.description: Type of Error.  If 'E' then Error.  If 'W' then 'Warning'.

columns.name: ERROR_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Detailed description of the error. It provides a seeded message if it fails business validation or SQL error code and message if it fails any system validation.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTITY
columns.description: Entity to which an error row corresponds. CLAUSES VARIABLES VALUESETS VSVALUES RELATIONSHIPS

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Identifies the Application name spawning the Concurrent Request
